lines: Create appHighlight, an attribute directive that highlights an element's background on hover with a configurable color (default yellow).

a1.cap: Attribute directives add behaviour to existing elements. The host metadata listens to DOM events and binds properties on the host element, and a signal tracks the hover state.
The square brackets make this an attribute selector.
Host listeners react to events on the element the directive sits on.
A host binding sets the background while hovered.
An input with the directive's own name receives the attribute's value, the color.
